$comment: Board-projection config read by scripts/render-boards.mjs. This file is fork-owned: the framework ships it once with placeholder values and template-sync never overwrites it. Every field degrades gracefully when null. The kanban is the headline board; the tech tree is experimental and projection-only — never a target (anti-Goodhart rules: docs/BEADS-CONVENTIONS.md).
$comment.campaign: Slug scoping the tech tree and enabling the kanban campaign filter; matches beads labeled campaign:<slug>. null = tech tree shows the full open dependency graph.
$comment.title: Project name shown in the board page titles (e.g. 'My Project — Kanban'). null = generic 'Kanban — the beads board' / 'Tech Tree — the beads DAG' titles.
$comment.phaseLabel: Eyebrow line above the board title (e.g. 'product build — foundation phase'). null = 'beads board' / 'beads DAG'.
$comment.victoryBeadId: Bead id of the campaign's terminal goal, highlighted as the victory node on the tech tree. null = the critical-path sink is used.
$comment.tracks: Array of track names fixing tech-tree column order and colors (matches beads labeled track:<name>). null = tracks are discovered from labels in encounter order.
